raw_comment: I notice that many states more towards the middle of the US have more serve droughts that states on the edge of the US. I wonder why these droughts are happening and what could we possibly do to prevent this from happening again. This relates to me and my community since there have been a lot of brush fires and wildfires recently since the drought. A catchy title could be How Siverly a Drought Affected States in the US

Could map to forest fires/fires, but the provided dictionary only confirms 'wildfires' and related fire terms indirectly.
